title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature enables yantraverse to handle JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, allowing developers to easily parse and access request data in their applications. It will improve the framework's usability and flexibility. By adding this feature, yantraverse will be able to support a wider range of use cases and become more competitive with other Node.js frameworks
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the framework can correctly parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, and the test cases pass without errors
reason: This feature is technically justified as it fills a gap in the framework's current functionality and aligns with the recent development focus on feature-driven development, which will improve the overall quality and usability of yantraverse
